title: Kettle Rainbow Parade
clips: Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. The kettle marches across the kitchen floor, cups following behind it like a parade Hoji bangs a spoon on a pan keeping the beat, Mariyam marches and claps
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. The parade marches through a door of rainbow steam into the playroom
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. Balloons, bubbles and confetti explode out of the kettle lid
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. Both kids spin in the colourful storm, hugging each other and laughing
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. The kettle shrinks back to tiny, hops onto the shelf, and winks at camera to close the arc
